title: Skirting — one Math Engine, four sections, mitred ends and a shadow-gap option
description:
A parametric SKIRTING on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT with Fit to host set to Exact and it takes the wall's full run. Until now `skirtHeight` existed only as a rate input inside the BOQ generator and drew nothing.

A SECTION IS A STACK OF BANDS. The quad-prism kernel extrudes plan quads vertically, so it cannot make a moulded profile in section. What it can make is two or three bands of decreasing thickness stacked up the height — which is exactly what a chamfered or bullnosed skirting looks like from a metre away, and is honest about being a step rather than a curve.

A MITRE IS STILL ONE QUAD. The wall edge keeps the full run and the front edge is pulled back by that band's own thickness at the mitred end, so a 45° cut is a trapezoid and needs no extra geometry. Each band mitres by its own thickness, which is what keeps a chamfered mitre reading correctly.

THE SHADOW GAP IS A REAL RECESS, not a missing band. The skirting starts at `gapHeight` and a set-back strip fills the space below it, so the reveal has a back face and `floatsAbove` reports the height it starts at.

SECTION AREA IS SUMMED FROM THE BANDS THAT EXIST, so the volume and the paint area follow the profile automatically instead of assuming a rectangle.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: a 3.00 m run, 76 mm high, 18 mm thick, one square band, 0.00137 m² of section, 0.28 m² to paint.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. No curved or ogee profile — three straight bands is the ceiling. It is one straight run: a skirting turning a corner is two of these, and the mitre flags are what makes them meet.

props.name: Material
props.value: MDF, ivory satin paint, flush with panel faces

props.name: Semantics
props.value: slim painted skirting, crisp shadow line, minimal contemporary trim

params.name: Skirting maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_t = thickness * _s
_td = min(topDetail * _s, _Ht / 2)
_gh = min(gapHeight * _s, _Ht / 2)
_gd = min(gapDepth * _s, _t * 0.8)
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _t
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
# v1 is the WALL face. Every band of the section is a quad from the wall forward by its own
# thickness, so a section is a STACK of bands in z rather than a shaped profile — that is the
# one thing the quad-prism kernel cannot do and the one place this object works around it.
_v1 = _t / 2
_wall = _v1
_isSq = profile == 'Square'
_isCh = profile == 'Chamfered'
_isBn = profile == 'Bullnose'
_isGap = profile == 'Shadow gap'
# A mitre is an ANGLED END IN PLAN, which is still one quad — the wall edge stays full length
# and the front edge is pulled back by the band's own thickness at that end.
_mL = mitreLeft > 0
_mR = mitreRight > 0
_z0 = _isGap ? _gh : 0
_zTop = _Ht
_zMain = (_isCh || _isBn) ? (_Ht - _td) : _Ht
_d1 = _t
_d2 = _isBn ? (_t * 0.72) : (_t * 0.5)
_d3 = _t * 0.38
_f1 = _wall - _d1
_f2 = _wall - _d2
_f3 = _wall - _d3
_mainA = _mL ? (_u0 + _d1) : _u0
_mainB = _mR ? (_u1 - _d1) : _u1
_MAIN = hcat(_u0, _wall, _u1, _wall, _mainB, _f1, _mainA, _f1, _z0, _zMain, 1)
_t2A = _mL ? (_u0 + _d2) : _u0
_t2B = _mR ? (_u1 - _d2) : _u1
_zB1 = _isBn ? (_Ht - _td * 0.45) : _Ht
_B2 = hcat(_u0, _wall, _u1, _wall, _t2B, _f2, _t2A, _f2, _zMain, _zB1, 1)
_BAND2 = (_isCh || _isBn) ? _B2 : zeros(0, 11)
_t3A = _mL ? (_u0 + _d3) : _u0
_t3B = _mR ? (_u1 - _d3) : _u1
_B3 = hcat(_u0, _wall, _u1, _wall, _t3B, _f3, _t3A, _f3, _zB1, _zTop, 1)
_BAND3 = _isBn ? _B3 : zeros(0, 11)
# The shadow gap is a REAL recessed band under the skirting, set back from the wall face.
_gf = _wall - (_t - _gd)
_gA = _mL ? (_u0 + (_t - _gd)) : _u0
_gB = _mR ? (_u1 - (_t - _gd)) : _u1
_G1 = hcat(_u0, _wall, _u1, _wall, _gB, _gf, _gA, _gf, 0, _gh, 2)
_GAP = _isGap ? _G1 : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_MAIN, _BAND2, _BAND3, _GAP)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Skirting3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
ShadowGap3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
SkirtingPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ShadowGapPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
runLength = _Ln
skirtingHeight = _Ht
skirtingThickness = _t
topOfSkirting = _zTop
bandCount = 1 + (_isCh || _isBn) + _isBn
sectionArea = _d1 * (_zMain - _z0) + (_isCh || _isBn) * _d2 * (_zB1 - _zMain) + _isBn * _d3 * (_zTop - _zB1)
paintArea = _Ln * (_Ht - _z0 + _d1)
volume = sectionArea * _Ln
floatsAbove = _z0
squareFlag = _isSq ? 1 : 0
